steps.speaker: laurah
steps.text: Welcome to Emberkeep, Keeper. I'm Laurah — last of the Dragon Masters. Three Dragon Eggs have slept here a hundred years… let's wake them.

steps.speaker: laurah
steps.text: Drag the three eggs together — bring them to one spot and watch what hatches.

steps.speaker: laurah
steps.text: Wonderful, isn't it? Let's keep merging.

steps.speaker: laurah
steps.text: Aren't you curious what happens when we merge these Gem Shards? Drag three together — make two Flame Gems.

steps.speaker: laurah
steps.text: What a wonderful colour, don't you think? Now we can gather the Flame Gems.

steps.speaker: laurah
steps.text: Let's bring them where the rest of the magic happens — open the Ledger, the scroll button.

steps.speaker: laurah
steps.text: There's Cindra's order — two Flame Gems. Press Deliver, and she'll hand you a Gold Key.

steps.speaker: laurah
steps.text: A Gold Key! Cindra's pleased, in her way. Now we can wake the land beyond the clouds.

steps.speaker: laurah
steps.text: A Gold Key! See the cloud wearing a key? Tap it — the key burns the fog away and opens the next stretch of the isle.

steps.speaker: laurah
steps.text: Emberkeep is waking, Keeper, and it's all your doing. Keep merging, hatch more dragons, and open new lands — the next gate takes two keys. Go on — make it warm again.
